candidates.description: This vector is related to character sequences and inflectional suffixes in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents common Hindi suffixes, inflectional endings, and character n-grams.
This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes, prefixes, and root components.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes, consonant clusters, or character n-grams typical of Devanagari script.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and common Hindi phonetic components.
This feature vector activates common Hindi verb roots and prefixes.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel and consonant-vowel combinations used in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents common Hindi conjunct consonants and vowel-consonant combinations used in word formation.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel sign diacritics combined with punctuation marks.
This vector represents Hindi character sequences, vowel signs, and common word fragments.
